newsitem.title: HUNGARY: TENNIS-COETZER WINS BUDAPEST OPEN WOMEN'S FINAL.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-COETZER WINS BUDAPEST OPEN WOMEN'S FINAL.

text.p: South African Amanda Coetzer beat Sabine Appelmans of Belgium in straight sets in the final of the Budapest Open women's tournament on Sunday.
Second-seeded Coetzer played a consistent baseline game to win 6-1 6-3 in one hour seven minutes.
Fourth-seeded Appelmans struggled with an erratic serve and though she managed a scattering of aces Coetzer's powerful returns prevented the Belgian from using her height advantage.
Coetzer, 11 cms shorter than her opponent at 1.57 metres, made up for the difference with speed and tenacity, making successful runs for seemingly lost balls.
Appelmans regained some of her composure at the beginning of the second set but Coetzer's passing shots eventually prevailed on the clay court.
